task: MIMIC-III 48h multi-note in-hospital mortality (label-leak fixed, survive-48h gate)
protocol: identical 1200 chars/note for EVERY system; seq 512; 3 epochs; LR grid {2e-5,5e-5}; best-epoch-on-val selection; neural arms verified at 6.16/6.14 notes and 372.8/374.5 tokens consumed
finding: At matched input, bag-of-words beats a 110M biomedical transformer by 0.050 AUROC / 0.100 AUPRC. PubMedBERT is outside the TF-IDF 95% CI [0.8553,0.8914].
retracted: An earlier 0.22 AUROC gap was a harness bug: the neural arms consumed 1.39 of 6.78 notes while the floor read all of them. Fixed; PubMedBERT recovered 0.6376 -> 0.8177.
caveats: validation not test; 314 val positives so CI ~ +/-0.03; single seed reported per selected LR; ours_pretrained excluded pending re-pretraining under a recorded input convention.
